title: Party hat rack
summary: A small rack of hats (party cone, tiny crown, Quincy cap) as head props; Askin swaps hats on the hour and comments on each one.

title: Deathdealing RAM meter
summary: An hourly behavior where Askin announces a made-up 'lethal dose' reading based on the time of day, with a pulsing Gift Ball animation and a pack of dosage quips.

title: Yhwach cameo at midnight
summary: At midnight a shadowy Yhwach silhouette prop appears behind Askin for a minute while he whispers nervous quips, then fades out.

title: Gift Ball Deluxe dome
summary: A double-click trick: a translucent purple dome animation expands around Askin with a rumble of sparkles, plus three dome-themed quips.

title: Lazy stretch routine
summary: A new idle animation where Askin stretches both arms, cracks his neck, and sighs, triggered randomly while idle with a 10 percent chance.

title: Seasonal outfits
summary: Scarf and earmuffs in winter months, sunglasses in summer, a tiny pumpkin in October: date-aware props with matching quips.

title: Taskbar fishing
summary: An interval behavior where Askin lowers a fishing line prop off the taskbar, waits, and reels in nonsense (a boot, a Gift Ball, a 'lethal dose of nothing') with quips.

title: Quincy quip pack vol. 2
summary: Forty new quips in Askin's voice about Sternritters, Soul Reapers, and the indignity of being a desktop pet, tagged for idle, lean, drag, and night.
